beats.narration_slice: Prometheus steals fire for humans.
beats.visual: Prometheus, rendered as an incised bronze-relief figure, reaches into a monumental divine brazier and pulls away a stylized flame while small terracotta human figures wait below.
beats.purpose: show Prometheus stealing divine fire for humanity
beats.visual_fingerprint: low-angle medium-wide palace furnace scene; Prometheus at upper left; diagonal arm carrying a gold-inlaid flame downward toward tiny waiting humans; monumental brazier dominates the right side
beats.continuity: establish the mythic world with the act that provokes Zeus

beats.narration_slice: Zeus responds by ordering Pandora’s creation.
beats.visual: Zeus sits frontally on a severe stone-and-bronze throne and extends one commanding hand toward a distant workshop doorway where an unfinished female clay silhouette stands.
beats.purpose: show Zeus initiating Pandora's creation as retaliation
beats.visual_fingerprint: symmetrical frontal throne composition; Zeus centered high in frame; command gesture toward a small workshop portal at lower right; unfinished clay woman visible in the doorway
beats.continuity: cuts from the stolen fire to Zeus's deliberate response

beats.narration_slice: Hephaestus shapes her from earth.
beats.visual: Inside a smoky artisan workshop, Hephaestus kneels beside a life-sized terracotta female form and presses wet earth into her shoulder with bronze shaping tools scattered nearby.
beats.purpose: show Pandora being physically shaped from earth
beats.visual_fingerprint: close three-quarter workshop view; kneeling Hephaestus on the left; unfinished Pandora reclining on a low clay platform to the right; hands molding terracotta under furnace raking light
beats.continuity: moves from Zeus's command into the workshop where it is carried out

beats.narration_slice: Athena clothes her and teaches skilled work.
beats.visual: Athena drapes a woven garment over Pandora while guiding her hands across a simple upright loom, combining dressing and instruction in one clear atelier scene.
beats.purpose: show Athena giving Pandora clothing and skilled craft
beats.visual_fingerprint: side-on medium shot in a loom chamber; Athena standing behind Pandora; patterned cloth forms a bold vertical band; Pandora's hands touch stretched warp threads; bronze shuttle visible near center
beats.continuity: continues Pandora's preparation but shifts from bodily creation to learned skill

beats.narration_slice: Aphrodite gives her grace and desire.
beats.visual: Aphrodite faces Pandora in a quiet courtyard and lifts a restrained gold-inlaid floral garland toward her as Pandora's once-rigid terracotta pose softens into an elegant stance.
beats.purpose: show Aphrodite endowing Pandora with grace and desire
beats.visual_fingerprint: waist-up paired figures in an open courtyard; Aphrodite at right raising a gold-accented garland; Pandora at left turning gracefully; curved floral motif echoes their silhouettes
beats.continuity: shifts from practical instruction to divine endowment

beats.narration_slice: Hermes gives her persuasive speech.
beats.visual: Hermes leans toward Pandora and gestures from his mouth with a carved ribbon-like breath motif that curls toward her face without containing any writing.
beats.purpose: show Hermes giving Pandora persuasive speech
beats.visual_fingerprint: tight profile two-shot against a dark plaster wall; Hermes on left speaking; abstract gold-and-teal speech ribbon arcs across negative space to Pandora on right; no text
beats.continuity: adds another divine gift while changing to a close symbolic composition

beats.narration_slice: Zeus sends Pandora to Epimetheus.
beats.visual: Pandora descends broad palace steps carrying a large covered pithos as Epimetheus waits at the far end of a sun-baked courtyard.
beats.purpose: show Pandora being sent toward Epimetheus
beats.visual_fingerprint: high-angle long shot; Pandora centered on descending diagonal steps with covered storage jar; Epimetheus small at lower right in open courtyard; Zeus's palace recedes behind
beats.continuity: moves from Pandora's preparation into her departure

beats.narration_slice: Prometheus had warned his brother not to trust Zeus’s gifts.
beats.visual: Prometheus grips Epimetheus by the forearm in a stark outdoor warning scene while, in the distance, a small divine gift procession is silhouetted against a palace gate.
beats.purpose: show Prometheus warning Epimetheus against gifts from Zeus
beats.visual_fingerprint: medium two-shot on a rocky ridge; Prometheus foreground left with raised warning hand; Epimetheus foreground right listening; tiny gift-bearing figures appear far below through a gate
beats.continuity: briefly steps back to the warning that makes Epimetheus's next choice significant

beats.narration_slice: Epimetheus accepts Pandora anyway.
beats.visual: Epimetheus reaches forward to welcome Pandora across a threshold, his open palm meeting hers while the covered pithos stands between them.
beats.purpose: show Epimetheus accepting Pandora despite the warning
beats.visual_fingerprint: frontal doorway composition; Epimetheus inside at left extending hand; Pandora outside at right; tall sealed pithos centered as the visual divider; warm low light crosses the threshold
beats.continuity: returns from the warning to the choice that ignores it

beats.narration_slice: Then comes the object we remember wrongly.
beats.visual: A single enormous covered clay vessel is isolated against a charcoal-dark archaeological wall, lit from the side so its deep body and narrow mouth become the entire focus.
beats.purpose: pivot attention from the characters to the misunderstood object
beats.visual_fingerprint: object-only close vertical composition; monumental vessel fills most of frame; narrow mouth near upper third; hard raking light reveals terracotta abrasion; figures absent
beats.continuity: pauses the character narrative to spotlight the central correction

beats.narration_slice: Her vessel is a pithos.
beats.visual: Pandora stands beside a towering pithos that rises nearly to her shoulder, one hand resting on its thick rim beneath a fitted clay lid.
beats.purpose: identify Pandora's vessel specifically as a pithos
beats.visual_fingerprint: full-body scale-comparison shot; Pandora at left; pithos at right occupying over half the frame height; thick handles and heavy clay walls clearly visible
beats.continuity: follows the object reveal by naming and scaling it against Pandora

beats.narration_slice: It is a large Greek storage jar, not literally a box.
beats.visual: In a palace storeroom, several large pithoi stand half-buried in the floor beside baskets and amphorae, while a small empty chest sits far off to one side only as a secondary contrast.
beats.purpose: explain that a pithos is a large storage jar rather than a box
beats.visual_fingerprint: wide storeroom interior; three monumental pithoi in staggered depth; floor cutaway suggests buried lower bodies; tiny plain chest relegated to distant corner; no labels
beats.continuity: expands from one pithos to its real storage context and scale

beats.narration_slice: The familiar box belongs to later tradition.
beats.visual: A visual time-bridge shows the ancient pithos fading into the background while a much later ornate lidded casket emerges in the foreground, separated by a worn fresco edge rather than by labels.
beats.purpose: distinguish the later box tradition from the earlier pithos
beats.visual_fingerprint: diagonal temporal contrast; weathered pithos recedes upper left; ornate later casket appears lower right; cracked plaster seam divides eras; no text or dates
beats.continuity: contrasts the historical object just explained with the later remembered form

beats.narration_slice: Pandora opens the jar.
beats.visual: Pandora braces one hand on the pithos and lifts the heavy clay lid with the other, revealing a narrow black opening rimmed by a faint restrained gold glow.
beats.purpose: show the moment Pandora opens the pithos
beats.visual_fingerprint: low close shot from rim height; Pandora bends over from upper left; heavy lid tilted diagonally upward; circular dark mouth dominates lower center; first glow appears within
beats.continuity: returns from historical clarification to the decisive action in the myth

beats.narration_slice: Troubles escape into human life.
beats.visual: Abstract winged and serpentine trouble-forms burst from the pithos and stream over a settlement below, turning into motifs of sickness, toil, conflict, and grief without readable symbols or text.
beats.purpose: show evils and hardships escaping into human life
beats.visual_fingerprint: dramatic upward-to-downward diagonal; jar mouth at lower left erupts with charcoal-and-teal forms; miniature human settlement spans lower right; four distinct trouble motifs spread across sky
beats.continuity: explodes the tension of the opened jar into its consequence for humanity

beats.narration_slice: She closes the lid, but not before they are gone.
beats.visual: Pandora slams the lid back onto the pithos while the last dark trouble-forms vanish beyond the frame, leaving only a few trailing curls in the air.
beats.purpose: show Pandora closing the vessel too late to contain the escaped troubles
beats.visual_fingerprint: dynamic overhead shot; both of Pandora's hands press the lid down; jar centered below; three retreating dark forms exit through upper corners; harsh raking light catches the sealed rim
beats.continuity: shows the immediate but ineffective response to the escape

beats.narration_slice: One thing remains inside: Elpis.
beats.visual: The sealed pithos is shown in a simplified cutaway, its dark interior empty except for one small enclosed gold-teal ember resting at the bottom.
beats.purpose: show that one thing, Elpis, remains inside the jar
beats.visual_fingerprint: centered cutaway vessel against limestone cream; thick terracotta walls shown in section; tiny luminous ember isolated at the lowest point; exterior sealed and still
beats.continuity: moves from the closed exterior to a revealing interior view

beats.narration_slice: Elpis is often translated as hope.
beats.visual: The small enclosed ember becomes a delicate sprouting flame-like form inside the pithos, visually suggesting hope while remaining ambiguous and contained.
beats.purpose: connect Elpis with the common translation of hope
beats.visual_fingerprint: macro interior view from inside the jar; single gold-inlaid ember at center grows into a small plant-flame shape; curved terracotta walls surround it like a dark cavern
beats.continuity: develops the remaining ember into the familiar hopeful interpretation

beats.narration_slice: What that remaining hope means is still debated.
beats.visual: The pithos sits between two opposing carved gestures: one open hand reaching toward the contained glow and one closed hand shielding it, creating a balanced unresolved composition with no text.
beats.purpose: show the uncertainty over whether retained hope is beneficial, withheld, or otherwise ambiguous
beats.visual_fingerprint: symbolic symmetrical composition; pithos centered; open bronze-relief hand enters from left; closed terracotta hand enters from right; small interior glow visible between them
beats.continuity: turns the hopeful image into a deliberate visual ambiguity rather than a settled answer

beats.narration_slice: So Hesiod’s Pandora is not just a simple villain.
beats.visual: Pandora stands alone beside the sealed pithos in a quiet courtyard, half in ochre light and half in teal shadow, with no accusing figures around her.
beats.purpose: present Pandora as a more complex figure than a simple villain
beats.visual_fingerprint: full-height contemplative portrait; Pandora slightly off-center left; sealed pithos behind her at right; split low raking light divides her figure into warm and cool value bands; empty courtyard creates moral ambiguity
beats.continuity: ends the body on a reflective character image after the unresolved meaning of Elpis
